THE PLATFORM

One platform. Three interview types.

Each one flexes between quant and qual. The third can layer onto the other two.

01  ·  STRUCTURED
Survey
Quantitative by default, qualitative when you need it. Closed-ended at scale, with branching and skip logic, or open-text when depth matters more than counts.
02  ·  LONGITUDINAL
Diary Study
Multi-day, multi-touch. Capture behaviour as it happens, across days or weeks. Qualitative by default, with quantitative ratings layered in when needed.
03  ·  CONVERSATIONAL
AI Interview
Qualitative depth, AI-moderated. Run standalone, attach to a Survey to probe deeper, or layer onto a Diary Study for narrative richness over time.

DATA QUALITY

Clean data, by design.

Every response runs through automated quality checks before it counts.

Speeding
Flags responses finished too fast to be real.
Gibberish
Catches nonsense and copy-paste answers.
Straight-lining
Detects the same option picked down a grid.
Red herring
Plants checks careless respondents miss.
Evidence
Asks for proof: a photo, receipt or voice note.

QUESTIONS, DROP-OFF & WHEN THIS WORKS

How many questions? As many as you need.

Length kills completion on a one-shot web survey. On WhatsApp the thread stays open, so people answer in their own time, the same number of questions, or more.

As fast as a browser
The WhatsApp click-through is instant. Questions render and submit as quickly as any web survey, with no speed trade-off.
Open for the whole fieldwork window
People finish across hours, days and weeks, not just minutes, which lifts engagement and completion on longer questionnaires.
Reminders that actually land
A WhatsApp nudge brings people back. An email asking them to please finish a survey gets ignored, or resented.
Second sessions still count
A half-finished web tab buried on a phone is a write-off. On WhatsApp people pick up exactly where they left off.
When customers actually finish their survey
